from pathlib import Path
p = Path('index.html')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'href="singup.html"'
new = 'href="signup.html"'
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'Expected exactly one {old!r}; found {s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY

set -eu
# Verify the landing-page CTA has exactly the intended local target before deployment.
python3 - <<'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path

class CTAParser(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.hrefs = []
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag == 'a' and dict(attrs).get('class') == 'cta':
            self.hrefs.append(dict(attrs).get('href'))

parser = CTAParser()
parser.feed(Path('index.html').read_text())
assert parser.hrefs == ['signup.html'], parser.hrefs
assert Path(parser.hrefs[0]).is_file(), parser.hrefs[0]
print('Verified CTA target: signup.html')
PY
./publish-site.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- latest deployment record ---'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
